```{r loading the WDI library}
library(WDI)
library(dplyr)

wb_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = c(
    population = "SP.POP.TOTL",
    gdp = "NY.GDP.PCAP.KD",
    life_exp = "SP.DYN.LE00.IN"
  ),
  start = 2019,
  end = 2022,
  extra = TRUE
)

wb_clean <- wb_data %>%
  transmute(
    country_code = iso2c,
    migration_year = year,
    population = population,
    gdp = gdp,
    life_exp = life_exp
  )

write_parquet(wb_clean, "wb_clean.parquet")
wb_clean <- read_parquet("wb_clean.parquet")

# Trouble shooting
names(migration)[is.na(names(migration)) | names(migration) == ""] <- "unnamed_col"
names(migration) <- make.names(names(migration), unique = TRUE)

migration <- migration %>%
  left_join(
    wb_clean,
    by = c("country_from_alpha_code" = "country_code",
           "migration_year" = "migration_year")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    wb_clean %>%
      rename(
        country_to_alpha_code = country_code,
        gdp_to = gdp,
        population_to = population,
        life_exp_to = life_exp
      ),
    by = c("country_to_alpha_code" = "country_to_alpha_code",
           "migration_year" = "migration_year")) %>%
  mutate(migration_gap_gdp = gdp_to - gdp,
         life_exp_gap = life_exp_to - life_exp,
         pop_gap = population_to - population)

migration <- migration %>%
  rename(
    gdp_from = gdp,
    life_exp_from = life_exp,
    population_from = population
  )

# Continent data

region_data <- migration %>%
  group_by(region_from, migration_year) %>%
  summarize(
    total_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_gdp_from = mean(gdp_from, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_life_exp_from = mean(life_exp_from, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r simple}
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(plotly)

# Add country names back to migration data
names(migration)[names(migration) == ""] <- "unnamed_col"
names(migration) <- make.names(names(migration), unique = TRUE)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Global Migration Patterns"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      # Origin filters
      h4("Origin (From)"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "filterTypeFrom",
        label = "Filter by:",
        choices = c("Country", "Region", "Continent")
      ),
      uiOutput("dynamicFromInput"),
      
      # Destination filters
      h4("Destination (To)"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "filterTypeTo",
        label = "Filter by:",
        choices = c("Country", "Region", "Continent")
      ),
      uiOutput("dynamicToInput"),
      
      # Month/Year slider
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "monthInput",
        label = "Month Range",
        min = 1,
        max = 12,
        value = c(1, 12),
        step = 1
      ),
      sliderInput(
        inputId = "yearInput",
        label = "Year Range",
        min = 2019,
        max = 2022,
        value = c(2019, 2020),
        step = 1,
        sep = "",
        ticks = TRUE
      ),
      checkboxInput(
        "perCapita", 
        "Show per capita migration", 
        FALSE
      )
    ),
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("migrationPlot", height = "500px"),
      br(), br(),
      plotlyOutput("gdpPlot", height = "400px"),
      br(), br(),
      plotlyOutput("lifeExpPlot", height = "400px"),
      br(), br(),
      DTOutput("results"),
      br(), br(),
      plotlyOutput("continentGdpPlot", height = "400px"),
      br(), br(),
      plotlyOutput("continentLifeExpPlot", height = "400px"),
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Dynamic FROM dropdown based on filter type
  output$dynamicFromInput <- renderUI({
    choices <- switch(input$filterTypeFrom,
      "Country" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$country_from_name))),
      "Region" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$region_from))),
      "Continent" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$continent_from)))
    )
    
    selectInput(
      inputId = "fromInput",
      label = paste("Select", input$filterTypeFrom),
      choices = choices,
      selected = choices[1]
    )
  })
  
  # Dynamic TO dropdown based on filter type
  output$dynamicToInput <- renderUI({
    choices <- switch(input$filterTypeTo,
      "Country" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$country_to_name))),
      "Region" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$region_to))),
      "Continent" = sort(unique(na.omit(migration$continent_to)))
    )
    
    selectInput(
      inputId = "toInput",
      label = paste("Select", input$filterTypeTo),
      choices = choices,
      selected = choices[1]
    )
  })
  
  # Filter data based on inputs
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$fromInput, input$toInput)
    
    # Determine which columns to filter on
    from_col <- switch(input$filterTypeFrom,
      "Country" = "country_from_name",
      "Region" = "region_from",
      "Continent" = "continent_from"
    )
    
    to_col <- switch(input$filterTypeTo,
      "Country" = "country_to_name",
      "Region" = "region_to",
      "Continent" = "continent_to"
    )
    
    migration %>%
      filter(
        .data[[from_col]] == input$fromInput,
        .data[[to_col]] == input$toInput,
        migration_month >= input$monthInput[1],
        migration_month <= input$monthInput[2],
        migration_year >= input$yearInput[1],
        migration_year <= input$yearInput[2]
      )
  })
  
  # Aggregated data for plotting
  plot_data <- reactive({
    df <- filtered_data() %>%
      group_by(migration_year, migration_month) %>%
      summarise(
        total_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_population = mean(population, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(date = as.Date(paste(migration_year, migration_month, "01", sep = "-")))
    
    if (input$perCapita) {
      df <- df %>%
        mutate(total_migrants = total_migrants / (avg_population + 1) * 1e6)
    }
    df
  })
  
  # Migrants Trend
  output$migrationPlot <- renderPlotly({
    data <- plot_data()
    
    if(nrow(data) == 0) {
      return(plotly_empty())
    }
    
    p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = date, y = total_migrants)) +
      geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Migration from", input$fromInput, "to", input$toInput),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Number of Migrants"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)
    
    ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  # Migration vs. GDP Plot
  output$gdpPlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- filtered_data()
    
    if(nrow(df) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
    
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = gdp_from, y = num_migrants)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = "Migration vs GDP (Origin Country)",
        x = "GDP per Capita",
        y = "Migrants"
      ) +
    theme_minimal() 
        ggplotly(p)
  })
  
  # Life Exp Plot
  output$lifeExpPlot <- renderPlotly({
  df <- filtered_data()
  
  if(nrow(df) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = life_exp_from, y = num_migrants)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = "Migration vs Life Expectancy (Origin Country)",
      x = "Life Expectancy",
      y = "Migrants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggplotly(p)
})
  
   # Data table
  output$results <- renderDT({
    filtered_data() %>%
      select(
        migration_year, 
        migration_month, 
        num_migrants, 
        country_from_name, 
        country_to_name,
        region_from, 
        region_to, 
        gdp_from, 
        migration_gap_gdp, 
        life_exp_from, 
        life_exp_gap,
        population_from,
        population_to) %>%
      arrange(migration_year, migration_month)
  })
  continent_data <- reactive({
    migration %>%
      group_by(continent_from, migration_year) %>%
      summarize(
        total_migrants = sum(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_gdp_from = mean(gdp_from, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_life_exp_from = mean(life_exp_from, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }) 
  
     output$continentLifeExpPlot <- renderPlotly({
      df <- continent_data()
      
      if(nrow(df) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
      
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_life_exp_from, y = total_migrants)) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
        labs(
          title = "Migration vs Life Expectancy (Continent Level)",
          x = "Average Life Expectancy",
          y = "Total Migrants"
        ) +
        theme_minimal()
      ggplotly(p)
    })
  
  output$continentGdpPlot <- renderPlotly({
    df <- continent_data()
    
    if(nrow(df) == 0) return(plotly_empty())
       
       p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = avg_gdp_from, y = total_migrants)) +
         geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
         geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
         labs(
           title = "Migration vs. GDP (Continent Level)",
           x = "Average GDP per Capita",
           y = "Total Migrants"
         ) + 
         theme_minimal()
       
       ggplotly(p)
})
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

# Some Analyses
```{r}
# Do people move towards richer countries?
cor(migration$num_migrants, migration$gdp_to, use = "complete.obs")  # r-squared = 0.04015468
cor(migration$num_migrants, migration$gdp_from, use = "complete.obs") # r-suqared = 0.00589419

#DO people move thorugh healhier countires?
cor(migration$num_migrants, migration$life_exp_to, use = "complete.obs") # 0.03717863
cor(migration$num_migrants, migration$life_exp_from, use = "complete.obs") # 0.02206183

# Does the gdp gap matter?
cor(migration$num_migrants, migration$gdp_to - migration$gdp_from, use = "complete.obs") # 0.0245025

# GDP relationship
ggplot(migration, aes(x = gdp_to, y = num_migrants)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_minimal()

# Life expectancy relationship
ggplot(migration, aes(x = life_exp_to, y = num_migrants)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_minimal()

# GDP Gap
ggplot(migration, aes(x = gdp_to - gdp_from, y = num_migrants)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_minimal()

# By continent
migration %>%
  group_by(continent_from) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_migrants = mean(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_gdp_gap = mean(gdp_to - gdp_from, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# By region
migration %>%
  group_by(region_from) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_migrants = mean(num_migrants, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_life_gap = mean(life_exp_to - life_exp_from, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# What matters?
model <- lm(
  num_migrants ~ gdp_from + gdp_to + life_exp_from + life_exp_to,
  data = migration
)

summary(model)


```
